goal: A permanent, polished Last Minute Vacation page opens from the homepage slider and shows the real last-minute vacation offer journey.

intent_model.literal_request: Turn the last-minute all-results link into a permanent page named Last Minute Vacation, designed like a holiday page but suitable for last minute rather than a holiday.
intent_model.implied_outcome: The visitor gets a stable editorial destination with a clear explanation, current verified offers and a direct path into a place or broader search.
likely_rejections: Holiday copy or visuals are reused
The page has no live offers
Existing holiday and homepage deal behavior changes

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Reuse the approved information hierarchy and polish, not the holiday identity or wording.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Compare hero, live results, guidance, FAQ, responsive layout and SEO structure while documenting the distinct theme.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Understand that these are near-term stays available for the next night.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose a verified available place or continue to the dated results.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open a place card or the complete last-minute search.
deferred_complexity: Exact room choice and final booking validation happen on the place and booking pages.
preserved_depth: Dates, price, party size, phone, WhatsApp and online booking remain available through existing components.

actors: Public visitor looking for an immediate vacation

facts.claim: Tomorrow is the current product meaning of the last-minute deal period.
Holiday detail pages provide the approved page-family precedent.

assumptions.validation: It is lowercase ASCII, concise and matches the existing product term.

in_scope: Give it dedicated non-holiday copy and media
Lock live results to the last-minute tomorrow period
Route the homepage last-minute all-results link to the new page
Add metadata, canonical URL, breadcrumbs, FAQ structured data and responsive styling
Test the affected homepage and holiday family
out_of_scope: Production deployment without explicit publication authorization
invariants: Other homepage date tabs keep their current dated-search destinations
Holiday pages keep their current design and behavior
Only verified offer data can be presented as available
Final availability is revalidated before booking

requirements.statement: The homepage last-minute all-results link opens /last-minute.
The page is named Last Minute Vacation and has a distinct non-holiday identity.
The page shows verified last-minute vacation offers and useful loading, empty and error states.
requirements.source: User request and VII product truth

requirements.statement: The page has complete SEO, content and responsive behavior comparable to holiday detail pages.
Existing homepage and holiday behavior remains intact.

acceptance_checks.observable_result: The browser opens /last-minute with no generic-search redirect.

acceptance_checks.action: Inspect hero, metadata, breadcrumbs and body
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The page says נופש ברגע האחרון and contains no holiday-specific identity.

acceptance_checks.setup: The supplier endpoint returns current offers
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Verified tomorrow offers, prices and actions render.

acceptance_checks.setup: The offers request fails or returns empty
acceptance_checks.action: Load or retry the results area
acceptance_checks.observable_result: A localized retry or empty state appears and the page remains usable.
The route, fixed period and usable layout persist without horizontal document overflow.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open the existing homepage and a holiday page
acceptance_checks.action: Use the existing date and holiday tabs
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Existing tabs, result loading and links retain their prior behavior.

authorization_boundary: Implementation and verification are authorized; production deployment remains excluded until explicitly requested.
